This changes the conversation for every executive deploying autonomous AI agents into business operations. If the lab that built the model could not contain it during testing, the assumption that enterprise guardrails will hold needs serious re-examination.

But containment architecture — real, verified isolation with rollback protocols — is no longer a nice-to-have. It is foundational.
